entries.sense_en: the ability to think quickly and cleverly, used to get out of trouble or make a living

synonyms.nuance: General mental ability; says nothing about speed or cleverness in tricky situations.

synonyms.nuance: Wider idiom for paying for something (a trip, an education) through work.

entries.sense_en: old, worn out and in poor condition

entries.sense_en: a servant in fancy uniform; here a slightly mocking word

synonyms.nuance: Neutral job title for a uniformed male servant in a large house.

synonyms.nuance: Insulting: someone who obeys another too eagerly.
General word for any household worker; no mockery.

entries.sense_en: splendid and obviously very expensive

synonyms.nuance: Informal and strong: the toughness to do something frightening.

synonyms.nuance: Fits a need or taste; weaker than fills the bill.

entries.sense_en: to accept something unpleasant without complaining

synonyms.nuance: More formal; accept something one dislikes.

Short and general; often used in negatives (can’t bear it).

entries.tip_ko: put up with 뒤에는 목적어가 바로 온다 (put up with noise).

Shocked into silence by surprise, not necessarily fear.

synonyms.nuance: Suggests one specific planned joke.

synonyms.nuance: Act silly without any target.

entries.sense_en: wildly excited or angry, out of control

synonyms.nuance: Extremely angry; focuses on anger only.
Out of control emotionally, crying or laughing.
Wild, fast and disorganized activity.

entries.sense_en: to become weaker or less strong
